query: How do I paint a wooden spoon handle?

goal.title: Paint a wooden spatula handle purple
goal.description: Hold a wooden spatula and wipe its handle with crumpled paper towel, rotating it to reach the surfaces. Straighten the paper towel underneath and load a small blue-handled paintbrush from the linked paint pots. Apply purple paint along the exposed handle, repeatedly reloading the brush and rotating the spatula to coat its sides, edges and rounded end around the hanging hole. Set the painted utensil on the towel, wipe the brush, peel the white masking band from the handle, close the paint pot and wipe residual paint from the brush with paper towel.
goal.final_state: The wooden spatula lies on the paper towel with a purple-painted handle and an unpainted broad head. The masking band has been peeled off and cleanup is underway.
procedure: Wipe the wooden handle and arrange paper towel below it.
Load the brush and coat the handle purple while rotating it.
Touch up the edges and the end around the hanging hole.
Set the utensil down and remove the masking band.
Close the paint pot and wipe the brush.

phases.description: Wipe the bare wooden handle with paper towel, rotate the utensil and arrange a towel underneath.
Load the small brush and apply purple paint along the handle, rotating the utensil and reloading paint to cover the sides, edges and rounded end.
Set the painted spatula on the towel, wipe the brush, peel away the masking band, close the paint pot and continue wiping the brush.
